main.summary: Describes the outcome of attempting to append a staged stream transfer payload range.

property.name: Accepted
property.summary: True when the append request was accepted by storage.

property.name: AppendedLength
property.summary: The durable appended length after the attempted append completes.

property.name: Range
property.summary: The requested range associated with this append outcome.

property.name: Replayed
property.summary: True when an identical append was already committed or was reconciled.

property.name: StateVersion
property.summary: The durable session state version after the append attempt completes.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create a normalized stream transfer append result.
method.param: Requested range associated with the append attempt.
True when the append was accepted.
Durable appended length after the append attempt.
Durable state version after the append attempt completes.
True when matching content was already committed or reconciled.
